column1: # kernel/tools/ck_spinlock_pipe_locks.tsv: the reviewed lock calls of native/kernel/core/pipe.c, one line per caller
# and callee: caller, callee, number of calls (bl or b) in the -O0 aarch64 build, tab-separated. Read by
# tools/ck_spinlock_asm_check.sh (make spinlock-asm-check): the -O0 build must have these lines and no others, and
# at -O2 each caller has as many lock masks as pool_lock calls here and from one up to as many releases as
# pool_unlock calls here. A gate anchor (tools/gate-anchors.txt): change it only with the reviewed change of pipe.c.
